section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch46 — Ancient & Medieval India — Deep 4
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Delhi Sultanate was ruled successively by five dynasties. Which dynasty came FIRST, established by Qutb-ud-din Aibak?
explanation: The Delhi Sultanate began with the Slave (Mamluk) dynasty (1206), founded by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, followed in sequence by the Khilji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, and Lodi dynasties.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch46 — Ancient & Medieval India — Deep 4
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Mughal Empire in India was founded by Babur after his victory in the First Battle of Panipat (1526) against which ruler?
explanation: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi, the last Delhi Sultanate ruler, at the First Battle of Panipat (1526), establishing Mughal rule in India.
